temple.name: Shree Ramchandra Temple
temple.description: A sacred Vaishnava temple dedicated to Lord Ram, Sita, and Lakshman, serving devotees for generations on the banks of the Bagmati River.

about.deities: Lord Ram, Mata Sita, and Lakshman
about.significance: The temple is a revered Vaishnava shrine where devotees gather to offer prayers, sing bhajans, and seek blessings of Lord Ram, Sita, and Lakshman.
about.established: The temple was established by Late Mr. Sanak Singh Tandon Lahuri Chhetri and has served the community for generations.
about.aartiTimings: Morning Aarti around 6:00 AM and Evening (Sandhya) Aarti around 6:30 PM daily.

history.title: History of Shree Ramchandra Temple
history.summary: The temple has long been a spiritual heart of the Gaushala community, providing a serene space for prayer, bhajan, and community festivals. It is a living tradition passed down through generations.

timeline.event: Established by Late Mr. Sanak Singh Tandon Lahuri Chhetri to serve the community as a sacred Vaishnava shrine.
Devotees gathered regularly for Ram Navami, Satsang, and annual festivals, strengthening community faith.
A dedicated committee of coordinators and members manages the temple's services, events, and community hall.

visiting.info: The temple welcomes all devotees for darshan, aarti, and community programs.
visiting.howToReach: The temple is located at Battisputali, Gaushala, Kathmandu. It is near the Bagmati River and easily reachable by bus, taxi, or private vehicle from central Kathmandu.
visiting.guidelines: Please dress modestly, remove shoes before entering the sanctum, and maintain silence during aarti.
visiting.bestTime: Early morning (for Mangala Aarti) or evening (for Sandhya Aarti) are the most serene times to visit.

donations.info: Support the temple through donations. Your contributions help maintain the temple and support community programs.

booking.info: Bookings are available for temple events, ceremonies, and community hall rental.

faqs.question: What are the temple hours?
faqs.answer: The temple is open daily from 5:00 AM to 10:00 PM for darshan and prayers.

faqs.question: Where is the temple located?
faqs.answer: The temple is located at Battisputali, Gaushala, Kathmandu, Nepal.

faqs.question: How can I donate to the temple?
faqs.answer: You can donate through bank transfer, cash, online payment, or cheque. Please contact info@ramchandratemple.org.np for details.

faqs.question: Can I book the temple for events?
faqs.answer: Yes, bookings are available for temple events, ceremonies, and community hall rental. Contact info@ramchandratemple.org.np or call +977-1-4598526.

faqs.question: Who founded the temple?
faqs.answer: The temple was founded by Late Mr. Sanak Singh Tandon Lahuri Chhetri.

faqs.question: What are the aarti timings?
faqs.answer: Morning Mangala Aarti is around 6:00 AM and Evening Sandhya Aarti is around 6:30 PM, with additional aartis in the morning and late night.
